thoughts: I hope the visitors like my new snowflake designs.
My paws feel a little tired from all the building.
The town really comes alive in the winter.
I wonder if the fountain will freeze over soon.
Pip is getting so creative with his yarn projects.
I need to make sure the shop stall is stocked for the weekend.
The music sounds better when the town is quiet.
I am proud of the progress we have made this month.
